name: extract_textract_ocr_tool
description: Run Amazon Textract OCR on one DOCX page marked textract_ocr. Accepted output is emitted as a schema-valid BADGERS content-tree XML page. Low-quality, empty, symbol-dominated, or low-confidence OCR is explicitly routed to BADGERS Vision instead.

image_path.description: S3 URI for a rendered DOCX page image.

result.description: JSON with ocr_result_uri, optional content_tree_uri, schema validation status, quality metrics, and next_route. next_route=native_complete means content_tree_uri is the canonical page spine; next_route=vision_ai means use the same source image in the BADGERS visual workflow.
